notes: Empty arg yields "Give what to who?".
give N <noncoin> (or bare "give N") yields "You can't give more than one item at a time.".
C do_give parses each token with one_argument (fill-skip + lowercase); Go doGive used strings.Fields. Give-local routing fix.
Missing recipient yields "To who?".
Recipient not in room yields the NOPERSON line.
Giving to yourself yields "What's the point of that?".
get_obj_in_list_vis miss yields "You don't seem to have a/an X.".
give all. X yields "All of what?".
give all X with empty inventory yields "You don't seem to be holding anything.".
Actor "You give $p to $N.", victim "$n gives you $p." (TO_VICT), bystander "$n gives $p to $N." (TO_NOTVICT).
give all.X gives each matching item to the recipient.
give all gives the whole inventory.
NODROP object below immort yields "You can't let go of $p!!  Yeech!".
Recipient at carry cap yields "$N seems to have $S hands full.".
Recipient over weight yields "$E can't carry that much weight.".
give 0 coins X yields "Heh heh heh ... we are jolly funny today, eh?".
Giving more coins than held yields "You don't have that many coins!".
Actor "Ok.", victim "$n gives you N gold coins." (TO_VICT), bystander "$n gives <money_desc> to $N." (TO_NOTVICT).
